purpose: Independent schema/session cross-checks; no exchange continuity certification or calendar override

sources.title: Databento aggregate bars
sources.findings: OHLCV buckets use trade receive timestamps; empty trade intervals emit no record. Supported native intervals are second, minute, hour and day. Vendor construction can differ in conditions, trade breaks and publication timing.

sources.title: Databento trades
sources.findings: Receive and matching-engine timestamps are distinct. Executed trades have action T and preserve price, quantity, sequence, flags and side; the documented fields do not provide a unique execution identifier.

sources.title: Databento status
sources.findings: Trading state is best-effort tri-state. Action None denotes no change. Historical midnight snapshots repeat a last status whose effective event timestamp may precede the request.

sources.title: Databento CME supplement
sources.findings: CME trade summaries become Trade records; passive fills are separate MBO detail and are absent from trades/MBP-n. Receive and exchange clocks retain nanosecond precision.

sources.title: Databento common flags
sources.findings: Bad-receive-clock, unrecoverable-gap and snapshot flags need explicit handling. A native sequence or serialized-byte equality is not an independent trade identifier.

sources.title: CME Gold futures fact card
sources.findings: GC is the standard 100-ounce contract. Regular Globex trading runs Sunday 17:00 to Friday 16:00 Chicago time, with the daily 16:00-17:00 maintenance interruption. This is a nominal cross-check, not a substitute for historical holiday/contract status evidence.

sources.title: CME trading hours and holidays
sources.findings: Pre-open, pause and closed states differ from matching-enabled open. The 2026 Labor Day schedule concerns September 6-8; dynamic product-specific hours and native reviewed exceptions take priority. September 21 is not a listed US Globex holiday; unrelated product/platform holiday tables must not be applied to GC.
